proof_scope: Primary-main scheduling boundaries and live read-only GitHub/checkout observations; not live authoring or closure

claims.proves: WebGPT-authored adversarial boundary checks, real remote-content admission for Tau #315, and unrelated-lease isolation for Battle #1500
claims.does_not_prove: Unattended live repair, provider execution, scheduler-loss recovery, or ticket closure; those require the separate live canary

cases.name: primary-main-adversarial-boundaries
command: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d /mnt/storage12tb/skills/project-watchdog/outputs/primary-boundaries.XXXXXX); cd ..; uv run --project . python evals/primary_main_revision.py unit --output "$d/result.json"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["status"]=="PASS" and r["executed"]>=44 and all(c["status"]=="PASS" for c in r["cases"]); print("BOUNDARIES_READ_BACK", r["executed"], "MOCKED_GITHUB_PROVIDER")' "$d/result.json"
cases.proves: Real Git and subprocess boundary experiments; GitHub and provider effects are simulated

cases.name: live-tau315-comma-targets-and-remote-admission
command: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d /mnt/storage12tb/skills/project-watchdog/outputs/primary-tau-observe.XXXXXX); cd ..; uv run --project . python evals/primary_main_revision.py observe --project tau --issue 315 --output "$d/result.json" > "$d/stdout.json"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["targets"]==["src/tau_coding/dag_runtime/agent_node_adapter.py","src/tau_coding/runtime_backends/herdr.py"]; assert r["authoring_executed"] is False; active=r["writer_active"]; assert (r["exclusion"]=="leased" and any(o["issue_number"]==315 and o["targets"]==r["targets"] and o["phase"]=="running" for o in r["recovery"]["operations"])) if active else set(r["classification"].values())=={"verified_remote_identical"}; print("LIVE_TAU_TARGETS_OBSERVED_NO_AUTHORING", "ACTIVE_RESERVATION_EXCLUDES_DUPLICATE" if active else "REMOTE_IDENTICAL_ADMITTED")' "$d/result.json"
cases.proves: Real GitHub marker parsing: shipped targets are admitted when idle; an active same-ticket reservation and GitHub lease exclude duplicate authoring while the creator changes those files
cases.does_not_prove: Issue 315 repaired or its proof obligations satisfied

cases.name: live-battle-scoped-admission-and-default-state
command: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d /mnt/storage12tb/skills/project-watchdog/outputs/primary-battle-observe.XXXXXX); cd ..; uv run --project . python evals/primary_main_revision.py observe --project battle --issue 1500 --output "$d/result.json" > "$d/stdout.json"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert r["targets"]==["skills/battle/spectator"]; assert r["scope_conflict"] is False; assert r["effective_project_state"]=="active"; assert r["authoring_executed"] is False; assert all(v=="verified_remote_identical" for v in r["classification"].values()); print("LIVE_BATTLE_SCOPE_CLEAR_NO_AUTHORING", r["foreign_leases"])' "$d/result.json"
cases.proves: Real Battle target content, current lease-scope observation, and active registry-default policy; synthetic foreign-lease negatives are covered separately by the boundary case
cases.does_not_prove: Battle authoring or closure, or removal of any hold
